description: This file defines the `Tokenizer` class used for tokenizing strings with customizable delimiters, supporting multi-character delimiters and trimming options. It is a utility component likely used in expression parsing within the project.

classes.name: Tokenizer
classes.description: A string tokenizer that supports delimiters longer than one character, with trimming options and delimiter parsing capabilities.

methods.name: Tokenizer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the tokenizer with a list of delimiters, setting up internal patterns if needed.

methods.name: isTrimTokens
methods.description: Returns whether tokens are trimmed when tokenized.

methods.name: setTrimTokens
methods.description: Sets whether tokens should be trimmed.

methods.name: tokenize
methods.description: Converts a string into an iterator of tokens based on the delimiters.
